videos.headline: Gamecocks' Joyce Edwards credits practice reps for improvement
videos.description: After scoring 22 points for her 10th game of 20 or more this season in No. 3 South Carolina's 93-58 win over Arkansas, Edwards says hard work has led to better consistency.
